note: Real screens of the reference instance for the two canvas guides (Shape a workbook on the canvas, Edit a model on the canvas), 1440 px wide, taken by guide/tools/screens.mjs --file CANVAS.screens.json into guide/public/screens/canvas-*.png. Run the whole file in order: canvas-workbook-setup makes the draft 'Busbetrieb Nord canvas' as a person does (Settings, Workspaces, New workspace from a workbook with guide/samples/Haltestellen_Busbetrieb_Nord.xlsx, then Adjust), canvas-model-setup makes 'Guide canvas draft' (Settings, Model, New draft) and puts one deliberate issue in it (the state draft-ghost); both are deleted by the last two setup recipes. A screen with "setup": true only makes or removes a state and writes no picture.

screens.name: canvas-workbook-setup
screens.shows: Makes the workbook draft: New workspace from a workbook (the Haltestellen sample workbook, named Busbetrieb Nord canvas), Read the workbook, Adjust. Nothing is created in a workspace.

screens.name: canvas-workbook-open
screens.shows: The canvas after Adjust, with a proposed workbook draft: the Editor | Canvas switch, Workbook sheets and columns on the left, the object-type cards on the board, the Inspector at the right, the Proposed marks and the Workbook check strip.

screens.name: canvas-workbook-connect
screens.shows: Two object types connected: Connect on the Haltestellen card dropped on the Namen card, the new line between them, the notice that the link is made and Undo. The connection is taken back afterwards.

screens.name: canvas-workbook-readings
screens.shows: A workbook column's ⋯ menu on the canvas: Add to…, Use as a filter of…, Fill blanks from the cell above, Rows holding only this column are headings…, Make an object type of its values, Leave out.

waitFor.name: Fill blanks from the cell above

expect: Fill blanks from the cell above

screens.name: canvas-workbook-columns-as-rows
screens.shows: Three columns (Perron A, B and C) chosen on the workbook side and the question 'Read 3 columns as rows' (into which object type; the two new column names come next).

screens.name: canvas-workbook-navigation
screens.shows: The Navigation tab of the Inspector beside the board.

screens.name: canvas-workbook-refused
screens.shows: The rows refused for an object type: the refusal count and reason, the unmatched values and the ways on.

screens.name: canvas-workbook-create-dialog
screens.shows: The Create workspace dialog after a completed check, with the draft canvas behind it. Cancelled.

screens.name: canvas-workbook-teardown
screens.shows: Removes the draft 'Busbetrieb Nord canvas' (no workspace was created from it).

screens.name: canvas-model-setup
screens.shows: Makes the model draft: Settings, Model, New draft named 'Guide canvas draft' on the active release, with one deliberate issue in it (a column ghost-field in the Municipalities view of Network) so the draft has a change and a useful issue.

screens.name: canvas-model-whole
screens.shows: The whole model on the canvas: application frames, object-type cards with their marks (Released, Changed in the draft), the Showing choice, zoom and Fit.

screens.name: canvas-model-add-menu
screens.shows: The + menu of the header on a draft without a workbook: Application…, Object type…, Attribute type…, Relation type… and Navigation group….

screens.name: canvas-model-attribute
screens.shows: An attribute selected on a card with the Inspector open: its name, value type, Required, Unique and the ⋯ menu of its operations.

screens.name: canvas-model-relation-rule
screens.shows: A relationship line's rule popover: How many, Required, Attributes of the relationship, Which records may be chosen and All operations.

screens.name: canvas-model-navigation
screens.shows: The Navigation tab of the Inspector: the applications' groups and entries and their menus.

screens.name: canvas-model-views
screens.shows: The Views tab of the Inspector for an object type: the views and their Edit layout and preview controls.

screens.name: canvas-model-consumer
screens.shows: The Consumer APIs tab of the Inspector with the contract of the model selected.

screens.name: canvas-model-issues
screens.shows: The Issues drawer open with the deliberate issue (a view lists a field that does not exist) and its link to the view.

screens.name: canvas-model-history
screens.shows: The History tab of the drawer: the saved steps and the Undo action.

screens.name: canvas-model-teardown
screens.shows: Removes the draft 'Guide canvas draft'.
